content.thinking: The problem: `unsigned char(p[i])` — functional cast syntax with `unsigned char` needs parentheses: `(unsigned char)(p[i])`. Let me fix those.

cd /workspace/submission && python3 - << 'PY'

src=src.replace("int mode = unsigned char(q[1]);","int mode = (unsigned char)(q[1]);")
